en.headline: Hang Seng closes 68 points higher back above 24,000
en.dek: The index finished at 24,040 after an early dip of nearly 140 points, while main-board turnover fell to HK$98.1 billion.
body: Hong Kong stocks recovered from an early loss to finish higher on Monday, the first full session after the National Day holiday. The Hang Seng Index closed at 24,040, up 68 points, or about 0.3 per cent, RTHK reported. It had fallen nearly 140 points at the morning low before reclaiming the 24,000 level. Main-board turnover shrank to HK$98.1 billion.

The Hang Seng Tech Index closed at 4,183, up more than 0.6 per cent. Chip and artificial-intelligence names were firmer: Zhipu rose more than 6 per cent, and Lenovo gained nearly 5 per cent, the best blue-chip performance of the day, RTHK said. HSBC and Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing bounced, but only modestly. AIA fell about 0.4 per cent.

Property and landlords were under pressure. Wharf REIC, Henderson Land and MTR Corporation fell between nearly 2 per cent and more than 3 per cent, Longfor dropped more than 3 per cent, and Sun Hung Kai Properties and CK Asset were down about 1 per cent or more. Mainland markets remain closed for the holiday and are due to reopen on 8 October, so northbound trading was absent.

zh.headline: 港股收市升68點 重上24000點
zh.dek: 恒生指數收報24040點，早段曾最多跌近140點，全日主板成交減至981億元。
body: 港股星期一國慶假期後復市，先跌後升，全日升幅有限。香港電台報道，恒生指數早段最多跌近140點，其後反覆向上，收復24000點關口，收市報24040點，升68點，升幅約0.3%。主板成交額減至981億元。
恒生科技指數收報4183點，升逾0.6%。晶片及人工智能大模型股份造好，智譜升逾6%，聯想集團升近5%，是表現最好的藍籌股。匯控及港交所反彈，但升幅有限，友邦再跌約0.4%。
地產及收租股受壓。九龍倉置業、恒基地產及港鐵跌近2%至逾3%，龍湖集團跌逾3%，新鴻基地產及長實集團跌約1%或以上。內地市場假期休市至10月8日才重開，北水缺席。
